It was a privilege attending the bill signing for [image: It was a privilege attending the bill signing for the Robert Smalls Monument Commission. A former member of the State House, State Senate and U.S. Congress during Reconstruction, Robert Smalls is a pivotal figure in SC history and is deserving of such an honor on State House grounds. To learn more about his trailblazing and heroic career, read here: https://www.nps.gov/people/robert-smalls.htm]
